headline: IDF raises northern alert, places 36th + 91st divisions on 'extremely high' operational alert in Golan Heights and southern
dek: Israel raised its northern alert over the weekend and placed the 36th and 91st divisions on 'an extremely high state of operational alert' in the Golan Heights and southern Lebanon. Maariv claims Lebanese sources said Hezbollah received 'a green light from Iran to raise its readiness and prepare…
sources: Maariv military correspondent Avi Ashkenazi (Saturday edition) via L'Orient Today (Beirut); alert itself independently reported by KAN via Turkiye Today (~Oct 16)
fault_line: Is Israel bracing for a real multi-front attack before the election — or manufacturing a pre-election crisis to justify a northern strike?

sections.what_happened: Israel raised its northern alert over the weekend and placed the 36th and 91st divisions on 'an extremely high state of operational alert' in the Golan Heights and southern Lebanon. Maariv claims Lebanese sources said Hezbollah received 'a green light from Iran to raise its readiness and prepare for a possible confrontation with Israel,' and that Hezbollah is recruiting and fortifying positions in the Bekaa Valley, along the coast and in Beirut's southern suburbs. Maariv adds its own caveat: 'no specific intelligence indicating an Iranian effort to interfere' in Israel's Oct 27 election — the disruption scenario is a 'working assumption'.
sections.what_verified: KAN (Israeli public broadcaster, via Turkiye Today) independently reported 2 days ago that the IDF raised its alert level over possible Iran/Hezbollah escalation ahead of the Oct 27 election, with 'no concrete intelligence' of an imminent attack — corroborates the alert posture. IsraelHayom (Oct 18) reports Lebanese FM publicly pressuring Iran the same weekend. Golani Brigade redeployment to Northern Command reported earlier by IDF statement (news.az).
sections.what_disputed: The 'green light from Iran' claim is single-sourced (unnamed Lebanese sources via Maariv) with no independent confirmation; Iran denies fomenting escalation. Maariv's own caveat ('no specific intelligence') undercuts it. No Iranian or Hezbollah statement confirms readiness raise; no Western wire confirms division-level deployment orders.
sections.why_matters: Map-led northern-front briefing: alert + 36th/91st divisions, Golan and southern Lebanon; layer the 'green light' claim as ALLEGATION with Maariv's own caveat. TOTW stance: report the posture facts from the sources' own words, do not amplify the unverified Iranian green-light claim as fact. Fault-line ending: election-timing question.
sections.context: Background: Israel/Lebanon — NEW: IDF raises northern alert, places 36th + 91st divisions on 'extremely high' operational alert in Golan Heights and southern Lebanon (Maariv); claims Hezbollah 'green light from Iran'
